analyst_summary: Synthetic fixtures—not live observations—show strong stockout pressure, but a market-shop discoverability block may prevent restocking. The price-frontier issue and 9 versus 20 mature paid observations also limit diagnosis. Keep current parameters and resolve discoverability before testing coverage; retain all stated supply, price-cap, and refund safeguards.
